relevance.rationale: FILE ABSENT (a prior ledger row itself notes no local PDF is available while still setting source.file to this path). Identity unverifiable here. CORPUS-SIDE AUDIT — this is the finding: the key is the most heavily cited in my slice (~80 sites across lifting-and-descent, Torsion, LiftingDescent, brings-surface, climax-volume-mass, stochastic-mechanics, mass-endomorphism), and the DOI attached inline in the Lean disagrees with the registered one at EVERY site that carries one. Counting distinct DOI strings on lines mentioning this key in *.lean: SIX distinct variants over 20 lines, and ZERO occurrences of the registered value. Variant A (8 lines): descent-condition.lean:20, cosimplicial-crossed-groupoid.lean:133, weak-equiv-invariance.lean:20, global-gluing.lean:22, QOU/Torsion/DescentCondition.lean:17, QOU/Torsion/GlobalGluing.lean:21, stochastic-mechanics/classical-limit-obstruction.lean:13 and :48. Variant B (3): quantum-characteristic-classes-unique.lean:33 and :47, quantum-characteristic-classes-exists.lean:16. Variant C (3): climax-volume-mass/vertex-algebra-jet-relations.lean:23 and :109, brings-surface/genus-filtration-ideal.lean:26. Variant D (2, a book DOI rather than an article one): QOU/LiftingDescent/HomologicalCondensation.lean:24, QOU/LiftingDescent/BBStratification.lean:42. Variant E (2): QOU/ClassicalLimitObstruction.lean:54 and :76. Variant F (2, a different journal's prefix): lifting-and-descent/p3-blowup-yekutieli.lean:36, QOU/FluidDynamics/yekutieli_obstruction_level.lean:53. SEPARATE WRONG-TITLE SITE: QOU/LiftingDescent/ccg_crossed_module_structure.lean:17 renders this key under the title belonging to yekutieli2015, not the one the registered entry carries. The corpus has already caught one instance of exactly this key confusion — QOU/Archimedean/HyperbolicVolumeTranscendence.lean:39-40 carries an inline note that the key was previously used wrongly there for the same reason — so the failure mode is known and recurring. The cited locators themselves (Thm 1.7 at yekutieli-lifting.lean:27 and yekutieli-mapping-table.md:18; Thm 4.5 at global-gluing-proof.md; Def 2.1 at ccg-crossed-module-structure.lean:42) are specific and plausible but unverifiable without the document.

proposedActions.rationale: Six distinct inline DOIs and one wrong title are attached to this key across ~20 Lean sites, and none matches the registered entry. Normalise the inline -- Ref: DOIs to the registered value, or drop them and let references.ts own the metadata (which AGENTS.md prefers), and fix the wrong title at ccg_crossed_module_structure.lean:17.

The Thm 1.7 / Thm 4.5 / Def 2.1 locators relied on at yekutieli-lifting.lean:27, global-gluing-proof.md and ccg-crossed-module-structure.lean:42 are unverified because no copy of the document is present. Obtain it and confirm the locators before the next proof-integration pass leans on them.
